fields.label: Section
fields.description: Groups the options of an item: Ingredients, Side, Drink, Cooking… Its rules go in the Sections table. Not used in an Option List.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: Included: part of the item, comes checked and can be removed ("NO Tomato"). Optional: can be added (or is the one chosen).

fields.label: Component
fields.description: The item it is: an ingredient, a side, a drink, another dish. Empty: just an instruction for the kitchen (cooking point, no salt…).

fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown to the waiter and printed. Empty: the component's name.

fields.label: Price
fields.description: Optional: what it adds. Included: what it's worth (taken off when removed, if it changes the price; the whole price when the item is priced from components).

fields.label: Changes the price
fields.description: Off: choosing or removing it never changes the price.

fields.label: Up to
fields.description: How many times it can be chosen (Cheese x2).

fields.label: Portion
fields.description: How much of the component goes in one unit, in its stock unit (e.g. 30 g). When the component is a line of the item's recipe, the recipe's quantity is used.

fields.label: Default variant
fields.description: When the component has variants (sizes…): the one included. Bigger ones charge the difference. Empty: the cheapest.
